criteria.text: Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Marlow Holdings Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
